performance_claim_scope: W7900/gfx1100 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q4_K_M/BF16-KV Generation-2 shared-slot packed AR decode promoted from registered physical widths (1,2) to (1,2,4,8); byte-exact at c4/c8 and end-to-end exact c1-c32, with c4/c8/c17/c32 throughput recovered from the c2 cap
decision: promote gfx1100 shared-slot physical c4/c8 to the default registered widths; logical c4 lowers to one physical c4 and logical c8 to one physical c8

supersedes.finding: that pre-flip diagnostic measured c8 at 0.298x the old design because logical c8 lowered to c2 groups; the c4/c8 promotion closes that gap to ~0.97x

byte_exact_gates.oracle: independent c1, tokens + Conv/GDN state + live KV + every layer hidden

end_to_end_f1_sweep.workload: p128/d8, token_budget, zero batch window, same-server c1 oracle, c1..c32 + live 17

matched_c8.workload: p128/d8, 1 warmup + 3 measured, same-server c1 oracle

old_protocol_apples_to_apples.workload: p512/d128, SSE streaming-primary, 20 ms batch window, 256 prefill chunk, ctx 1024, 1 warmup + 3 measured, independent c1 oracles
old_protocol_apples_to_apples.note: burst rows measured before the live-admission step; the live step hit the known C2-6 GPU page-fault blocker (see open_issue)

open_issue.summary: p512/d128 c8 live-admission (new-harness join-after-N-decode) hit a GPU memory-access-fault (page not present) after the burst/streaming reps; the c8 live at p128/d8 and c17 live pass cleanly. This is the same ROCm page-fault instability that blocks the canonical C2-6 full-load packet and also appeared pre-flip (as HTTP 499 cancellation). Not caused by the c4/c8 promotion; tracked under the C2-6 canonical load blocker.
open_issue.server_log_line: Memory access fault by GPU node-1 ... Reason: Page not present or supervisor privilege.

limitations: p512/d128 c8 live-admission not closed due to the known C2-6 GPU page-fault blocker; the burst/streaming c8 parity numbers were measured before that step.
c17/c32 sweep rows are single-measured (production-packet shape); the matched 1w3m packet was run at c8 for a robust claim.
No full canonical C2-6 load (tuning/ragged/Poisson/overload/soak) is claimed here; that remains blocked by the GPU fault.
next: Fold into C2-6: re-attempt the canonical full-load packet once the ROCm page-fault instability is resolved.
Re-check p512/d128 c8 live-admission on a clean ROCm state to confirm it is the hardware fault, not a width-specific bug.
